Learn the launcher surface, search, styling, shell bridge, and optional AI tools
Android could not open that settings page.
A full Termux terminal as your Android home

Termux reimagined as a home launcher. You get the full Termux terminal and package ecosystem, alongside an app dock, instant search, an on-device AI backend, and enough Material polish to make it feel at home on Android.

Tap an app in the dock, or scrub across the A–Z rail to filter. Slide upwards into the results and let go over an app to launch it. From the terminal, type % followed by an app name to search instantly.

The terminal, dock, and keyboard share colours from your wallpaper, with a glass finish you can tune to your liking. Adjust the blur, spacing, colours, and icon packs anytime under Settings → Appearance.
Quickly respond to your messages and alerts by swiping up from a pinned app icon that has a pending notification — without leaving home.
Set it as home and go

That covers the launcher itself. From here you can shape the shell however you like, or start with the prebuilt profile and tweak it as you go — Fish, tmux, an Oh My Posh prompt, Shizuku system stats, Material theming, extra keys, zoxide, eza, and more.
